name: ai-scraping-executor
description: AI Web Scraping Executor — plataforma agnóstica de scraping asistida por IA (Crawlee + NestJS)

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w worker
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @ai-scraper/shared-core && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/domain-execution && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/domain-scraper && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/shared-security && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/shared-observability && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/domain-ai && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/application-execution && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/infrastructure-crawler && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/infrastructure-execution && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/application-ai && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/application-scraper && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/infrastructure-ai-providers && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/infrastructure-mongodb && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/infrastructure-redis && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/infrastructure-storage && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/infrastructure-webhooks && npm run build -w @ai-scraper/infrastructure-queue
scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w worker
scripts.test: vitest run --coverage tests/dsl.test.mjs tests/dsl-completeness.test.mjs tests/engine.test.mjs tests/engine-learned.test.mjs tests/engine-ratelimit.test.mjs tests/engine-render.test.mjs tests/dedupe.test.mjs tests/crawler.test.mjs tests/ai-providers.test.mjs tests/agent.test.mjs tests/persistence.test.mjs tests/dashboard.test.mjs tests/security.test.mjs tests/browser.test.mjs tests/api-hardening.test.mjs tests/observability.test.mjs tests/scale.test.mjs tests/normalize.test.mjs tests/llm-cache.test.mjs tests/interpret.test.mjs tests/resilience.test.mjs tests/sessions.test.mjs tests/credentials.test.mjs tests/cache-isolation.test.mjs tests/limits.test.mjs tests/first-user.test.mjs tests/logging.test.mjs tests/util-unify.test.mjs tests/metrics-labels.test.mjs tests/retry-cleanup.test.mjs tests/browser-ssrf.test.mjs tests/property.test.mjs tests/domain-execution.test.mjs tests/job-use-cases.test.mjs tests/session-use-cases.test.mjs tests/site-use-cases.test.mjs tests/user-use-cases.test.mjs tests/scraper-use-cases.test.mjs tests/architecture.test.mjs tests/webhooks.test.mjs tests/schedules.test.mjs tests/api-keys.test.mjs tests/progress-render.test.mjs tests/precision.test.mjs tests/validation.test.mjs scripts/rules/solid-s-layers.test.mjs scripts/rules/solid-o-extensibility.test.mjs scripts/rules/solid-l-substitution.test.mjs scripts/rules/solid-i-segregation.test.mjs scripts/rules/solid-d-inversion.test.mjs
scripts.dev:e2e: docker compose up -d postgres mongodb redis && sleep 10 && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: eslint apps libs scripts --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs
